decisions.reason: After another year on the market without signs of failure, this close-to-core finishing product likely remains near or above aspiration levels and is worth retaining given portfolio slack in a growing market.

Its distance from the established offer still makes it the riskiest product against aspiration levels, but its flagship role and fit with the firm's digital finishing direction make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
As a flagship B2 multifinishing system tightly aligned with the firm's core postpress portfolio and automation strategy, it is very likely to stay unless results clearly fall below aspirations.
The documented customer use provides concrete evidence of problem-solution fit, so management is likely to judge it as meeting aspirations and keep it as a complementary add-on within the core offer.
